bandIntro: Asura Falls stand for high-energy modern metalcore with a clear message, massive riffs, and two unmistakable voices. The six-piece band combines melodic depth, emotional intensity, and uncommon diversity into their music.

With influences from Bullet For My Valentine, Killswitch Engage, and In Flames, Asura Falls create a powerful blend of catchy melodies, aggressive breakdowns, and atmospheric moments. Clean vocals and raw screams meet heavy guitar riffs, surprising you at every turn.

Since the relaunch with Jenny and Nemo on vocals, the band has gained a fresh dynamic. Together with Jonas (8-string guitar), Cons (7-string lead guitar), Sueri (bass), and Erasmus (drums), they form a six-piece powerhouse ready to conquer stages.

Whether on big stages or in intimate club shows, Asura Falls stand for authenticity, passion, and electrifying live energy. The band transforms small clubs and large stages alike into a sea of movement and emotion.
With new songs and upcoming shows, Asura Falls are ready for the next step — uncompromising, honest, and driven by a clear goal: to bring their music to the world.
memberBios: Even as a small child, Jenny loved being on stage — no matter where she was. If she liked a song, she would sing along and dance to it. During her teenage years, her musical talent developed steadily, and she has been singing in bands ever since. With her captivating stage presence and a compelling voice that ranges from soft and sensitive to powerful and aggressive, she brings tremendous dynamic energy to the band.

Nemo discovered his passion for music at an early age and, many years later, is now the frontman of Asura Falls. With his long-standing experience as a shouter, rapper, and lyricist, he brings intense conviction and raw emotion to every performance, captivating audiences with his powerful stage presence.

Inspired by his music teacher, Jonas began his musical journey relatively late — but all the more determined. His path — and with it the search for his own sound — was shaped by countless bands and artists, from classic rock to modern metal. Armed with eight strings and his songwriting skills, Jonas lays a foundation of heaviness and melancholy on which the band builds its songs. Even though he rarely stands in the spotlight, he is indispensable as the rhythm guitarist and the band's in-house tech guy, making a crucial contribution to their overall sound.

Since day one, Cons has been a founding member, lead guitarist, and therefore the veteran of our band. He has been playing guitar since the age of eight, and his influences from classic blues and metal have played a major role in shaping the distinctive Asura sound. Inspired by modern core bands, he transforms ideas into melodic riffs and enhances them with atmospheric synth elements.

Sueri discovered his passion for low tones at the age of 14 — his roots lie in the skate punk of the early 2000s. After a longer break, he has been a permanent member of Asura Falls since 2016 and, as the band's valued bassist, provides the essential foundation that makes our music truly complete.

Although he masters several instruments, his true passion lies behind the drums. Influenced by a wide range of styles — from video game soundtracks to progressive metal — his playing combines powerful beats with playful fills, creating a distinctive energy that drives Asura Falls forward.
historyParagraphs: The story of Asura Falls began in 2014 — not in a rehearsal room, but during lively nights of drinks, backyard parties, and long evenings filled with music. Guitarists Cons and Schosch, who at the time were playing in different bands and exploring different musical worlds, always had one thing in common: their guitars. Whenever they got together, original riffs, spontaneous song ideas, and high-energy covers naturally took shape. It quickly became clear that something far greater than just a pastime was beginning to emerge.

Inspired by bands like Killswitch Engage and Parkway Drive, the idea of creating a band of their own began to take shape. Together with Alex on drums and Thomas on bass, the first lineup of Asura Falls was formed. Shortly afterwards, Basti joined as the vocalist, completing the band.

The first live performances soon followed. In 2015, Asura Falls made their live debut at Möwa Rockt. This was followed by numerous band contests and performances at youth centers, where the band built a reputation with a steadily growing catalog of original songs while gaining valuable live experience.

Over the following years, Asura Falls continued to evolve. Lineup changes shaped the band's journey, and their sound steadily matured. After Thomas' departure, Sueri took over on bass. A major turning point came in 2018 when founding guitarist Schosch left the band. Jonas soon joined the lineup, bringing exceptional technical skill, strong musicality, and renewed creative energy.

Things did not always run smoothly. The band repeatedly struggled with a lack of permanent members, especially for vocals and drums. During the COVID-19 pandemic, finding new musicians became almost impossible. Nevertheless, the band refused to give up. Dennis joined on drums and Erik as vocalist; together they explored new sounds and worked intensively on new material despite the lack of live shows.

After Erik’s departure, Asura Falls once again found themselves without a vocalist. During a casting process, the band discovered two exceptional voices. The chemistry was immediate, and with Jenny and Nemo, Asura Falls finally found a vocal duo that perfectly matched the band’s musical vision.

Shortly afterwards, drummer Dennis left Asura Falls. Once again, the band showed resilience. With Erasmus, they found a drummer whose technical skills and powerful beats elevated the band’s sound to a new level — and who remains an integral part of Asura Falls today.

Today, Asura Falls stands as a band that has never given up despite numerous setbacks. Driven by passion, unity, and constant evolution, their story proves that true music is born from perseverance, friendship, and an unwavering determination to keep moving forward.
